title: RadioSonde Closest Approach Distance
dataSources: APRS packets (`aprs:packet`), WSPR spots (`wspr:spot`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`), NOAA APT captures (`noaa:apt`), meteor-scatter pings (`meteorscatter:ping`), SSTV images (`sstv:image`).
app: Software-defined radio and ham stations — APRS igate, WSPR beacon, NOAA weather-satellite (APT) receiver, meteor-scatter monitor, and SSTV decoder — logging to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=radiosonde:track
stats min(distance_km) as closest by sonde_id
description: Records closest approach distance for each radiosonde pass.
value: Surfacing radiosonde closest approach distance helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant radio, sdr & space export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It produces when radiosonde closest approach distance matters for your routine.
